svg.title: Tech stack of Alex Földvári as a periodic table
svg.desc: 47 technologies in 8 groups (Languages, Frontend, Data, Backend, AI, Integrations and payments, DevOps and tooling, Design). Core: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Angular, HTML, CSS/SCSS, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Node.js. Used in real projects: PHP, Vite, Framer Motion, shadcn/ui, PostgreSQL, Neon, Firebase, MongoDB, REST APIs, OpenAI API, Vapi.ai, Stripe, Swiss QR-bill, Számlázz.hu, Resend, GoHighLevel, Smartsheet, Google APIs, Git, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Playwright, Vitest, Figma. Familiar: Python, Java, C#, React Native, Three.js, MySQL, Redis, Spring Boot, Claude API, Gemini API, n8n, Docker, Photoshop. On load the table assembles once: the group labels and rules draw in, the tiles appear group by group in a diagonal wave and the core tiles fill with blue last, then the card stays still.
